rv.q: Josie Rourke’s production is ferocious but light on its feet.
This is an uneven but bold probing of a dirty little secret in society that finds, in Ambika Mod, an eloquent expression of underlying pain.
Porn Play is by turns funny and disturbing – a welcome and bold addition to the growing discourse surrounding sex and the internet.
It's a bold play with a fantastically committed performance from Mod.
The unfortunate upshot of this is that we, like everyone in Ani’s life, feel very distant from her.
Sophia Chetin-Leuner has written a brave play on a difficult subject: pornography.
In Porn Play’s final moments, shame and grief mingle together in a harrowing display that shows not only the skill of its lead performer, but the craft of its ambitious young writer.
Mod and the others turn a rather superficial script into a show that, for all its defects, is worth seeing.
Porn Play is an interesting watch that made me not just think, but read the whole playtext through.

cn.t: Bold exploration of porn addiction features an acclaimed performance from Ambika Mod and striking staging, though critics are divided on whether the play maintains emotional connection with its protagonist.
